description: Nielsen audience-validation audit pings on the exact /cgi-bin/gn endpoint. Existing integration, session and product fields retain their checks. HTTPS is required; GET and captured cross-origin Content-Type checks give advice for avoiding browser preflight. Full CORS behavior, session linkage and delivery require external context.

params.name: prd
params.description: It marks the request as an audit ping. Nielsen documents the ads audit URL as /cgi-bin/gn?prd=audit.
params.fix_hint: Set prd=audit on every ads audit ping.

params.name: intid
params.description: It is the integration ID Nielsen assigns for all audit pings across platforms.
params.fix_hint: Set intid to the integration ID Nielsen issued.

params.name: sessionid
params.description: It is the session ID generated when the player is instantiated. Nielsen documents it as mandatory.
params.fix_hint: Send a stable sessionid for the playback session, and fire again if it changes.

params.name: product
params.description: It names the Nielsen product the ping corresponds to. Nielsen documents examples dar, dcr, and dtvr.
params.fix_hint: Set product to the Nielsen product for this integration, such as dar, dcr, or dtvr.

params.name: createtm
params.description: It is the time the ping was fired. Nielsen documents createtm as Unix time.
params.fix_hint: Set createtm to the Unix timestamp when the ping fired, such as 1643858542.

params.name: apid
params.description: It is the Nielsen Server App ID. Nielsen documents apid as required only for content measurement.
params.fix_hint: Send apid when this audit ping is for content measurement.

rules.message: Nielsen requires its Server App ID for content measurement audit pings.
Nielsen documents audit pings as HTTPS requests.
rules.fix_hint: Use https://audit.imrworldwide.com/cgi-bin/gn with the generated audit parameters.

params.name: method
params.description: Nielsen prefers simple GET audit requests to avoid preflight. This is advice rather than a universal receiver method enumeration.

params.name: headers.origin
params.description: Capture context for cross-origin browser transport advice. No Origin header is required and its syntax is not newly constrained.

params.name: content_type
params.description: For a captured request carrying a non-collector Origin, these MIME essences are CORS-safelisted. A different media type can require preflight, which Nielsen warns its downstream collectors reject. Header absence is allowed.
params.fix_hint: For browser cross-origin audit GETs, omit Content-Type or use a CORS-safelisted media type, such as text/plain.

params.name: headers.content-type
params.description: Fetch limits a CORS-safelisted Content-Type value to 128 bytes and excludes CORS-unsafe bytes. For a captured Latin-1 header value each character is one byte, including MIME parameters. Values outside Latin-1 remain unverified by this raw-header advice. This does not certify the complete browser preflight decision.
params.fix_hint: Use a short Content-Type value without CORS-unsafe bytes. For this audit GET, the header may also be omitted.
